description: Social Mentions & Sentiment: daily mention counts, distinct authors and mean VADER sentiment for a brand, product or topic over the last 1-7 days, plus the top 10 co-occurring terms. Sources: Bluesky and Hacker News, plus Reddit and X (latest, newest first) when available. One page per source: days beyond its reach come back truncated (coverage_from). Aggregate only, no text, no authors; a day under 20 known authors is suppressed. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged.
